facts: Mac CLI and Docker probes experienced TCP connection timeouts to application and EC2 API; STS and SSM remained accessible.
SSM saw three healthy containers and verified local/public HTTPS readiness from the EC2.
An independent Azure VM verified AWS public readiness HTTP200. Chrome also obtained ready response.
Mac CLI subsequently recovered without network, security-group, instance or application modifications.
cause: Not determined; evidence does not establish a general application outage.

monitor_configuration_followup.cause: Reconfiguring the AWS dashboard also atomically replaced the metrics-token mount file; only Grafana had initially been recreated, leaving the old Prometheus bind mount unavailable.
monitor_configuration_followup.resolution: Recreated only AWS Prometheus with its existing data volume and current token mount; no application or network change.
